slides.headline:
Promised
*number one*
on Google?
slides.sub:
Two myths, and what Google
itself says about them.

slides.title:
Pay Google,
rank higher?
instead:
You can pay Google
to move up the results.
try:
Google doesn't accept payment
to rank a site higher.
Ads are separate. Google says advertising has no effect on where your site shows in the normal results.

slides.title:
Top spot,
guaranteed?
instead:
A good SEO company can
guarantee first place.
try:
"No one can guarantee
a #1 ranking on Google."
Google's own words. If someone guarantees first place, its advice is to find someone else.
slides.source: Google Search Central, "Do you need an SEO?"

slides.title:
Ask these
instead
items: Can you show me previous work?
And how will you measure them.
Will you tell me every change?
It's your website. You should know what's been done to it.
